explication: Hollow is a browser-based Hollow Knight save editor. Users select or drag in a PC save, or choose Nintendo Switch mode for plain-text saves; the app loads JSON into an editor, lets users modify or reset it, and downloads an encrypted PC save or plain Switch save. Recent edits are kept in browser storage and can be reopened. The main control flow is visible in `src/index.js`; codec internals and history persistence are also sampled. Other UI and persistence details are represented only where documented or directly evidenced.
